The structure of CoN2 crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Co4N8) and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Co centers in an octahedral environment of six N neighbors, while N centers exhibit two distinct environments: a tetrahedral motif with two Co and two N neighbors, and a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve neighbors (six Co, six N). Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Co octahedra and N tetrahedra, as well as corner- and face-sharing among N polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
